item.title: Knee MWM During Squat / Step
clinicalUse: Painful squat/step in OA or mechanical knee pain when a corrective glide reduces symptoms
contact: Belt/contact around proximal tibia or knee according to chosen glide.
forceDirection: Sustained medial/lateral or AP corrective glide while patient squats/steps; direction determined by pain-free response.
mistakes: Using the same glide direction for everyone.
item.visualCue: Corrective knee glide + active squat/step → Retest without glide.

subTechniques.name: Tibial Glide + Active Knee Flexion/Extension
subTechniques.clinicalGoal: Improve painful active knee movement when a sustained tibial correction produces immediate improvement.
subTechniques.patientSetup: Standing, sitting or supine depending on the patient's painful movement; choose the position that reproduces the comparable sign.
subTechniques.contact: Use a belt or broad contact to sustain the tibial glide while controlling femoral/pelvic alignment.
subTechniques.direction: Maintain the pain-free accessory glide while the patient repeatedly performs flexion/extension or the relevant functional movement.
subTechniques.dosage: 6–10 repetitions × 2–3 sets if each repetition stays pain-free/easier.
subTechniques.reassess: Knee ROM, squat, step or sit-to-stand.
subTechniques.clinicalPearl: Do not choose the glide by theory alone—choose the one that immediately improves the patient's movement.
